action: USD held in a personal Hong Kong bank account -> exchange to HKD at that bank -> remit HKD to the same-name mainland bank account -> settle HKD to CNY at the mainland bank

officialSources.finding: Personal online/mobile same-name remittances to mainland BOC waive the basic outward fee for supported currencies. The terms exclude agent and other additional charges.
BOC Express supports HKD and USD. Its additional fees can include recipient bank costs and BOCHK extra handling; a basic-fee waiver alone does not establish total zero cost.
Electronic personal BOC Express basic fee is waived. The listed HKD160 USD agent precollection explicitly excludes mainland China; that exclusion is not a universal zero-agent-fee promise.

operationReference.finding: The author reports several free same-name HKD transfers from BOCHK to mainland BOC followed by mainland settlement, describing transfers within HKD10,000.
operationReference.scope: Reference for the described small HKD operation only, not an actual bank service cap or fee guarantee for all amounts, USD, ordinary SWIFT, other banks, or reversed directions.

notAdopted: Guide suggestions to misdescribe the real remittance purpose or split transfers to evade checks.
General marketing claims of unlimited remittances and universal zero fees without actual amount, route or fee evidence.
A copied third-party article that mixes card balances, account management fees and claims an unrelated HKD60 agent charge.

pricing.hongKong: Selected returning bank's actual USD/HKD bidPerUsd
pricing.mainland: Selected mainland receiving bank's actual HKD cash-transfer buy price in CNY per HKD
pricing.retainOnMissingMainlandPrice: HKD after the priced conversion and known remittance fees
